title: Profile resident relation-to-HNF exact lifetimes
objective: Add a deterministic same-work compiler/lifetime ledger for the resident relation-to-HNF path at integration commit 944a12911, without compiler changes, and state one falsifiable optimization proposal.

oracles: Generated C structure and frozen connected relation/HNF fixtures

runs.notes: Two independent runs against the commit-944a12911 connected-relation/HNF core and frozen four-field input were byte-identical.
merge:check passed; unit tier could not start because the fresh lane had not yet built dist/tools/compiler.js.

handoff.summary: Added a deterministic read-only call-graph/lifetime profiler and ledger for the exact resident relation-to-HNF kernel at 944a12911. The native graph has zero fmpz lifecycle sites because it is an mpz_t backend, but 2470 mpz init sites, 4934 cleanup sites, 1372 integer-owner conversion sites, 199 reachable functions, 635 internal call sites, and 452-481 MB fixed-capacity owners for 15-16 MB logical payload.
risks: Lifecycle counts are static generated-C sites rather than dynamic executions; duplicated success/failure cleanup sites are documented explicitly.
Fixed-capacity bytes reproduce the diagnostic 64-limb policy and are live owner capacity, not measured peak allocator traffic.
next_steps: Run the falsifiable root-owned mpz scratch-frame A/B: require 75% fewer dynamically executed lifecycle calls, 3x kernel CPU improvement, and identical frozen-prefix state.
